name: Ichijou Kazuki
source:
Magician class: D
Magic wand: Ring[spoiler], a Magic item made by Haru-hime which eventually names herself "Sakura", she has an ability to protect the owner's memory, and to reclaim memory from other worlds; previous lives to the owners, the ring previously belonged to his mother Misora.[/spoiler]

The protagonist of the game. He is magician who have physical ability better then normal person.
